name: FUNCTION_COMPOSITION_REDUCTION
description: Replaces the graph bipartite coloring constraint with a functional composition constraint. Nodes become signal filters, edges become synchronization pairs, and colors become functions f(x)=x and f(x)=-x. The edge constraint is expressed as f_u(f_v(x)) = -x, which elegantly forces opposite modes without using any graph or logic terminology, requiring the model to algebraically deduce the mutually exclusive constraint.
